deployable_note: deployable:true means ACTIVELY TRADING IN SANDBOX (futures_follow precedent) — there is no scaffold/observe-only default state; it does NOT mean cleared for live. Live would additionally need the strategy_mode flip + the platform-global gate.

params.selection: top-3 gainers long / top-3 losers short by 09:15-open vs prev daily close
params.vol_baseline: running average of completed minute volumes since 09:15 (auction included in v0)
params.entry: mid-bar tick trigger: cumvol-in-minute >= vol_mult x baseline AND ltp beyond first-candle level
params.exit: hard flatten 09:30:00 IST, retry 09:32; no stop, no target

honest_context: Round 58: bar-level versions of this signal have NO honest edge (close entry -0.16%/trade; the published +0.38% was entry-level look-ahead). This sandbox run measures whether the legal mid-bar entry captures enough of the ~0.54% intra-bar burst. Decision rule: trigger entry must beat close entry by >=0.4pp/trade over ~30+ signals, else final REJECT.
ops: App must boot before 09:15 IST; late boot = day skipped (loud WARNING).
